title: THE STRENGTH OF
YOUR MIDDAY JOY
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: soft light streaming through a modern office window at noon
dust motes dancing in a sunlit empty room
still shadow on a wooden desk top
high midday sun over an open field
the reflection of white clouds in a quiet puddle
blurred motion of white curtains in breeze
an open notebook on a quiet wooden table
dappled light filtering through tree leaves

scenes.a: That heavy burden sitting on your chest feels lighter the moment you turn to God.
For the joy of the Lord is your strength.
Heavenly Father, life feels overwhelming during this busy stretch of the afternoon workday.
My tasks pile up and my spirit grows weary under the weight of these hours.
Grant me the grace to trade my exhaustion for Your boundless, quiet, everlasting joy.
Let Your presence be the foundation that upholds me through the remainder of this day.
May Your strength sustain my hands and calm my racing thoughts until the evening comes.
In the name of Jesus, amen.
